capabilities: Search books by title, author, publisher, or ISBN via the Google Books or Naver API
Create book notes from a configurable template with book metadata variables
Download and save book cover images into a designated vault folder
Render array fields like authors and categories as YAML lists or wikilinks with list, enum, and wikilist modifiers
Run inline scripts against the book object for custom template output
disambiguation: Not a vault search tool; it searches external book catalogs and creates new book notes from the results.
extras: Maintained fork of an inactive plugin; author discloses that some work is AI-assisted. Warns that Keychain-stored API secrets stay on one device and do not sync, and documents a migration path from plaintext keys. Notes the Google Books API's low free quota for unauthenticated requests.
intentEvidence: This is a personal fork of obsidian-book-search-plugin by anpigon, which has not been updated since October 2024.
motivation: The author forked obsidian-book-search-plugin, which had not been updated since October 2024, to apply fixes and improvements unavailable upstream.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up book metadata from an online catalog and turn it into a structured book note, so authors, ISBNs, and covers must be entered by hand.
